verses.translation: The Most Compassionate
taught the Quran
created humanity
˹and˺ taught them speech
The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision
The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺
As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺
so that you do not defraud the scales

verses.arabicText: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.transliteration: Wa-aqīmū l-wazna bil-qis'ṭi walā tukh'sirū l-mīzān
verses.translation: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure
He laid out the earth for all beings
In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks
and grain with husks, and aromatic plants
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny
He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery

verses.arabicText: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
verses.translation: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water
yet between them is a barrier they never cross
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
verses.transliteration: Walahu l-jawāri l-munshaātu fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlām
verses.translation: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
Every being on earth is bound to perish

verses.arabicText: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.transliteration: Wayabqā wajhu rabbika dhū l-jalāli wal-ik'rām
verses.translation: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
verses.transliteration: Yasaluhu man fī s-samāwāti wal-arḍi kulla yawmin huwa fī shan
verses.translation: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
We will soon attend to you ˹for judgment˺, O two multitudes ˹of jinn and humans˺
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
verses.transliteration: Yāmaʿshara l-jini wal-insi ini is'taṭaʿtum an tanfudhū min aqṭāri s-samāwāti wal-arḍi fa-unfudhū lā tanfudhūna illā bisul'ṭān
verses.translation: O assembly of jinn and humans! If you can penetrate beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, then do so. ˹But˺ you cannot do that without ˹Our˺ authority
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.translation: Flames of fire and ˹molten˺ copper will be sent against you, and you will not be able to defend one another
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-idhā inshaqqati s-samāu fakānat wardatan kal-dihān
verses.translation: ˹How horrible will it be˺ when the heavens will split apart, becoming rose-red like ˹burnt˺ oil
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.transliteration: Fayawma-idhil-lā yus'alu ʿan dhanbihi insuw-walā jānn
verses.translation: On that Day there will be no need for any human or jinn to be asked about their sins
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.transliteration: Yuʿ'rafu l-muj'rimūna bisīmāhum fayu'khadhu bil-nawāṣī wal-aqdām
verses.translation: The wicked will be recognized by their appearance, then will be seized by ˹their˺ forelocks and feet
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Hādhihi jahannamu allatī yukadhibu bihā l-muj'rimūn
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Hell which the wicked denied.”
They will alternate between its flames and scalding water
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
And whoever is in awe of standing before their Lord will have two Gardens
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
˹Both will be˺ with lush branches
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
In each ˹Garden˺ will be two flowing springs
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
In each will be two types of every fruit
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
verses.transliteration: Muttakiīna ʿalā furushin baṭāinuhā min is'tabraqiw-wajanā l-janatayni dān
verses.translation: Those ˹believers˺ will recline on furnishings lined with rich brocade. And the fruit of both Gardens will hang within reach
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.transliteration: Fīhinna qāṣirātu ṭ-ṭarfi lam yaṭmith'hunna insun qablahum walā jānn
verses.translation: In both ˹Gardens˺ will be maidens of modest gaze, who no human or jinn has ever touched before
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
Those ˹maidens˺ will be ˹as elegant˺ as rubies and coral
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
Is there any reward for goodness except goodness
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
And below these two ˹Gardens˺ will be two others
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
Both will be dark green
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
In each will be two gushing springs
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
In both will be fruit, palm trees, and pomegranates
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
In all Gardens will be noble, pleasant mates
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny
˹They will be˺ maidens with gorgeous eyes, reserved in pavilions
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.transliteration: Lam yaṭmith'hunna insun qablahum walā jānn
verses.translation: No human or jinn has ever touched these ˹maidens˺ before
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ
verses.translation: All ˹believers˺ will be reclining on green cushions and splendid carpets
Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.arabicText: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.transliteration: Tabāraka us'mu rabbika dhī l-jalāli wal-ik'rām
verses.translation: Blessed is the Name of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honour
